title: ID0421675-DC/Si-D/SG-[MP/R3 170001681] Unable to charge BYD E6
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
The vehicle was charging ok on V6.0.3 before his vehicle service date of 23rd April 2025 where the vehicle firmware is updated.
Solution : reduce the remote start delay to less than 60 sec

additional_info.subject: Sicharge D MP / R3 170001681: Unable to charge BYD E6
additional_info.body:
Dear Helpdesk
Sicharge D
Serial No: MP / R3 170001681
Charger ID: R1G8Ft
FW: V6.0.3
Vehicle Brand and Model: BYD E6
Issue:
The vehicle was charging ok on V6.0.3 before his vehicle service date of 23
rd
April 2025 where the vehicle firmware is updated.
@Jadhav, Nilesh (RC-SG SI B SU)
please kindly help to share the photo of the FW version number from the vehicle dashboard.
Today 30
th
April 2025, he attempted to charge on Sicharge D on V6.0.3, he is facing EV communication error.
Please kindly see the logs attached.
We will try to attempt the charging again next week to test. However, previously there was no issue in the EV communication to Sicharge D.
His vehicle was charging fine with ABB AC charger and Starcharge AC charger (with the updated vehicle firmware version).
Please let us know if the L2 need to be online supporting when we attempt the charging again.
Thank you
Edna Seah
SI E LC-SG
Siemens Pte Ltd.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0421675-DC/Si-D/SG-[MP/R3 170001681] Unable to charge BYD E6 CRM:02682000077
additional_info.body:
Hello Edna,
Upon analyzing the logs, prima facia it appears to be a delay in Authentication. See below
Vehicle Plugged in at
2025-04-30T01:49:08
.390236+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [4021] [DCC] DC1: PilotState "A" --> "B2"
RemoteStartTransaction at
2025-04-30T01:50:20
.
283922+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/510a6e79286b[736]: OCPP: Received command: RemoteStartTransaction (8926dd05-2499-4b6d-8ef8-bd7e48a59cd1) - {"idTag":"OXbGJzDhbJ","connectorId":1}
There was more than more than
1 min delay between connecting vehicle and authorizing the session
, which led to the communication timeout between EV-EVSE.
I would suggest starting another charging session with same EV. If you need us to monitor the session, please let us know the date and time.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Sharma
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
